Call the ask tool exactly once, with exactly this html argument and nothing else:
<form><fieldset><legend>Which databases?</legend><label><input type="checkbox" name="databases" value="sqlite" checked> SQLite</label><label><input type="checkbox" name="databases" value="postgres" checked> Postgres</label><label><input type="checkbox" name="databases" value="mysql"> MySQL</label><label><input type="checkbox" name="databases" value="duckdb"> DuckDB</label></fieldset><fieldset><legend>Which region?</legend><label><input type="radio" name="region" value="eu"> EU</label><label><input type="radio" name="region" value="us" checked> US</label><label><input type="radio" name="region" value="apac"> APAC</label></fieldset><label>Anything else? <input type="text" name="note"></label></form>
After it returns, reply with the single word DONE and stop. Do not call any other tool.
